title: OnAIR AI plugin deployment contract
description: Split per reviewer issue m2: this file describes the MODEL/ARTIFACT only. System-level schedulability belongs in analysis_report.json, not here. Since v0.9 only target/resources/artifact are required at top level (the v0.8 AArch64 contract has no model/interface/timing block); harness/make_contract.py emits all blocks.

profile.description: free-form profile label (historically fast|predictable|memory; v0.7 avx512; v0.8+ the --iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu value)

memory_boundary.description: v0.4 decision (option b): bounded region = static per-call buffers + module-resident constants, both from the compiler's allocation schedule. Runtime context, stacks, cFS pipes are attributed only, never bounded.

bounded_bytes.description: static_per_call_bytes + module_resident_constant_bytes; the figure compared against a budget

bound_method.description: static_from_stream_schedule: v0.3-v0.7 (pre-layout slice sums); static_from_stream_layout: v0.8+ (post-layout transient slab sizes, harness/make_contract.py). NONE means a size was not a compile-time constant; admission must return UNKNOWN_BOUND and bounded_bytes is null

kernel_task_stack_bytes.description: max stack-frame bytes over the executable's dispatch functions (ELF analysis). Task-stack budget bucket (proposal SS9.2 bucket 2), NOT part of bounded_bytes. null = not analysed

kernel_external_call_insns.description: call/bl/blr instructions in the embedded ELF; null = not analysed

llvm_alloca_count.description: `alloca` count in the codegen LLVM IR of the same invocation; null = not analysed

kernel_stack_classification.description: proposal SS9.2 bucket of kernel memory outside the HAL contract

unresolved_sizes.description: IR size symbols that were not compile-time constants (non-empty iff bound_method == NONE)

boundary.description: Reviewer issue C3: a bound is meaningless without its measurement boundary.

bound_method.description: measured_max is NOT a WCET. Level A/B/C must never be conflated.

artifact._comment_n5: bytes is required as of E24 (N5): both the C path (ai_learner.c blob size precheck before the hash, D15/E16) and the OnAIR path (plugins/compiled_learner/artifact_binding.py, D27/E23) refuse a contract without it, so leaving it optional here let a schema-valid contract be rejected by every consumer. All 17 contracts in this repo carry it.

single_invocation.description: true iff vmfb, layout IR and executable dumps come from ONE iree-compile invocation

shape.description: null = dynamic dimension (`?` in the MLIR signature); such a contract has bound_method NONE
